messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: prefix KV cache miss spike detected for /generation/* routes — error rate + latency increase. Pager sent to #oncall (sam). Severity: S2.

sam: paging through — I'm on it. seeing 5xx spike and token latency up across hosted cluster eu-west-1.

lia: acked. I'm joining, can we get a quick customer-impact summary?

sam: quick numbers: 11:36 -> normal. 11:40 -> hit-rate drop. Prom query: `sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_misses[1m])) by (shard)` shows spike on shard-7.

jordan: putting the metrics graph in thread: `kv_prefix_hit_ratio{route="/generation/*"}` dropped from ~0.98 to 0.15 between 11:39 and 11:41.

anya: customers affected: 3 PLG customers with heavy prefix use (alpha-app, notesinc, searchly). error rate for alpha-app 12% 5xx; others degraded latency only.

sam: initial mitigation applied: toggled fallback route to model-variant b (less cached), and enabled increased logging. That reduced 5xx but latency still up.

ops-bot: deploy-event: invalidation-job v2.3 started at 11:38:12 UTC by ops-scheduler.

sam: hypothesis tracker: H1: invalidation-job accidentally cleared prefix keys instead of stale-only. H2: new runtime change changed prefix key hashing causing mismatch (KV reuse miss). H3: upstream storage lag causing misses.

lia: can we pull logs from invalidation job and the KV service? need `--since 11:30` from the job pod.

jordan: pasted log snippet: ```
[11:38:12] invalidation-job: start sweep pattern=/generation/*
[11:38:13] invalidation-job: deleted 1,238 keys on shard-7
[11:38:14] kv-service: warn: key not found prefix=/generation/ctx-abc-*
[11:38:15] kv-service: info: rehydrate miss for shard-7
```

sam: that log looks bad — invalidation job definitely touched prefix keys. Did it run a dry-run flag?

anya: ops-scheduler shows job command: `--pattern=/generation/* --force --concurrency=8`. No dry-run.

lia: timeline so far: 11:36 normal; 11:38 job starts (force delete pattern); 11:39 hit-rate collapses; 11:40 5xx spike starts; 11:42 fallback to variant b enabled; 11:46 partial recovery for error rate; latency still 2-3x baseline.

jordan: deeper KV metrics: `kv_evictions_total` spiked same time; `kv_repopulate_seconds` shows rewarm traffic but only 30% rewarm success in first 5m.

sam: mitigation plan in-thread: 1) stop invalidation-job (done) 2) kick off targeted rewarm for top prefixes (script ready) 3) rollback invalidation-job to v2.2 config (remove --force) 4) follow-up RCA.

lia: executing targeted rewarm for alpha-app prefixes now. command: ```
./tools/rewarm-prefixes --tenant=alpha-app --route=/generation --concurrency=6
```

ops-bot: job stop command executed by sam at 11:49:05 UTC: `kubectl scale job invalidation-job --replicas=0`.

sam: rewarm job started at 11:51. initial rewarm logs: ```
[11:51:10] rewarm: queued 120 prefixes
[11:52:02] rewarm: succeeded 14/120 for shard-7
[11:52:03] rewarm: succeeded 46/120 for shard-3
```

zack: note: cache key formats changed in runtime branch `kv-key-stable` merged 2 days ago. Could be related. Jordan, can you confirm key serializer version across nodes?

jordan: checking. config shows mixed versions for runtime on some burst nodes — one older commit used different salt for prefix hashing. That would make older keys unrecoverable until rewarm populated new hashed keys.

sam: updating hypotheses: H1 (invalidation job forced deletion) confirmed as primary contributor; H2 (key serializer mismatch) likely exacerbated hit-rate because rewarm used new key format and older keys were not matched. H3 deprioritized (no evidence).

lia: customer impact update: alpha-app 5xx reduced to 1.5% after rewarm started; average p95 latency for /generation down from 2.1s to 1.3s but still above baseline 0.6s.

anya: action items (in-incident):
- stop invalidation-job (done)
- rollback job config to v2.2 (sam)
- schedule hot-cache rewarm window (ops)
- add safety guard to invalidation tool to prevent pattern-wide force deletes (PR base: ops-infra)
- detect mixed key-serializer nodes and coordinate rollback or migration (eng-runtime)

sam: performing rollback now: `kubectl apply -f invalidation-job-v2.2.yaml` -> waiting for confirmation.

jordan: will open a migration ticket to ensure key-serializer rollout is sequential and has compatibility shim. tagging: eng-runtime, eng-ml.

ops-bot: rollback applied at 12:05:22 UTC by sam.

lia: handoff: I'm staying on for next 30m to confirm rewarm stability. @sam can you do a quick handover note for the night oncall if you need to leave?

sam: short handoff note: invalidation force-delete caused prefix mass-eviction; rewarm in progress (started 11:51), rollback applied 12:05. Key-serializer mismatch may slow rewarm. Watch `kv_prefix_hit_ratio` and `rewarm_success_rate`. Paging if error rate >5% or p95 >2s.

zack: adding timeline entry to incident tracker sheet with logs link and sample key list.

anya: final in-thread decision: treat as S2, plan post-incident RCA focused on: invalidation-tool safety, rollout gating for key-serializer, and automated warmers after invalidation.

sam: closing in-thread mitigation. will convert this thread to a post-incident doc with owner assignments. good job team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident bot: note added to incident history."
